number.caption: French 10-year bond yield hits highest level since 2002

stories.title: French borrowing costs hit a 24-year high
stories.whats_going_on: The yield on French 10-year government bonds climbed to 5%. This jump follows a failure to pass the national budget and intense civil unrest over public spending cuts.
stories.what_it_means: Investors are demanding a higher return to lend money to the French government due to mounting political instability and fiscal worries. This marks the highest borrowing cost the country has seen since 2002.
stories.why_care: When government borrowing costs rise, it often ripples through the broader economy, eventually pushing up the cost of loans and mortgages for everyday households and businesses.

stories.title: SpaceX earnings launch tech stocks back into orbit
stories.whats_going_on: Stock markets climbed globally as a blockbuster earnings report from SpaceX spurred a sharp rally in tech shares. The upbeat results helped soothe investor worries about whether the massive global spending on artificial intelligence is sustainable.
stories.what_it_means: Wall Street welcomed concrete financial proof that big tech and AI-adjacent ventures can deliver strong profits. It temporarily pushed aside lingering doubts about sky-high valuations in the sector.
stories.why_care: If you hold broad market index funds or tech-focused investments, your portfolio likely caught a ride on today's upward wave, though high-flying tech sectors always carry extra volatility.

stories.title: Crude oil holds firm near $110 as supply jitters linger
stories.whats_going_on: Brent crude held close to $110 a barrel as traders monitored ongoing supply route risks. Geopolitical tensions in key waterways continue to keep energy markets on edge.
stories.what_it_means: Persistent high oil prices reflect a delicate balance between steady global demand and fragile supply chains. Energy costs remain a stubborn baseline pressure for the wider global economy.
stories.why_care: Steep oil prices eventually trickle down to the petrol pump, heating bills, and the cost of weekly groceries, nibbling away at household purchasing power.

stories.title: Gold steadies as traders game out future rate cuts
stories.whats_going_on: Gold prices steadied while US Treasury yields pulled back slightly. Traders are closely parsing economic data to guess the Federal Reserve's next moves on interest rates.
stories.what_it_means: Precious metals are hovering as investors wait for clearer signals on inflation and monetary policy. Markets are eager to see if central banks will pivot toward easing borrowing costs.
stories.why_care: Shifts in interest rate expectations dictate the returns you get on cash savings versus the allure of riskier assets like gold and equities.
